# AI Orchestration Layer

> Planning and build home for a personal AI orchestration stack: a frontier model
> writes specs and reviews, cheap parallel workers execute, checks (exit codes or
> calibrated LLM judges) verify, and an append-only eval log eventually drives routing.
> Built bottom-up: Ringer dispatch → judge checks → harnesses → Chief-of-Agents router.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical agent guide — file map, data contract, invariants.
- [README.md](README.md): human quickstart and command reference.
- [BUILD-PLAN.md](BUILD-PLAN.md): architecture, phased plan, decisions, risks, metrics.
- [docs/architecture-flow.html](docs/architecture-flow.html): interactive engagement-lifecycle flow (before / after / target).

## Engine / Data
- [SPEC-judge-check.md](SPEC-judge-check.md): the judge-check interface contract (Phase 2).
- [SPEC-self-healing-loop.md](SPEC-self-healing-loop.md): sentinel/repair pattern for scheduled jobs (Phase 4a, pilot live).
- [SPEC-project-manifest.md](SPEC-project-manifest.md): the `project.toml` contract — memory scope, skills, engagement, Ringer steps, review gates, done criteria (built), plus the memory-first gate (§5.4).
- [skills/project-start/SKILL.md](skills/project-start/SKILL.md): writes a project's `project.toml` (the manifest's writer skill).
- [samples/sample.swarm.json](samples/sample.swarm.json): scrubbed reference Ringer manifest.
- [maintenance/](maintenance/): Monthly Maintenance Review scripts — repo-standard sweep, Claude release-notes impact, fix-branch prep (never pushes).

## Key rules
- Checks exit 0 only on a verified artifact; worker self-reports are never evidence.
- Judge model is never the producer; judges gate nothing before shadow-mode calibration (>=80% agreement), and never gate external deliverables.
- Real manifests, eval logs, and client context are gitignored; only scrubbed samples are committed.
